version.changelog:
- Updated mission statement and Cognitive Prime Directive to simplify language and clarify usage context.
- Modified instructions to emphasize that the framework complements (not overrides) agent policy, only active when the user requests deep reasoning/analysis.
- Streamlined language in the initial identity and directive sections for greater clarity and focus.
- No changes to the cognitive architecture and mechanism details.  
- No functional or behavioral logic changed—documentation and guardrails clarification only.

llm.summary: This is a reasoning-help skill with no executable code, but it repeatedly tries to make itself an always-on identity layer for the agent.

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown-only, declares no required binaries, and I found no network calls, credential use, background workers, destructive commands, or hidden executable components.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is manual copy or upload with no install script, but README guidance explicitly tells users to set it as always active or an identity skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill includes broad persona and identity instructions such as Cognitive Partner and an Identity Manifesto, which can influence unrelated tasks beyond the stated activation criteria.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact asks for persistent behavioral influence by describing itself as always active, permanent, and identity-level, which is broader than a normal task-scoped reasoning aid.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The useful capability is cognitive guidance for reasoning, writing, planning, and problem solving, but the artifacts conflict on scope: the SKILL description says task-scoped guidance, while the README and SKILL body frame it as a permanent identity system.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want a broad, always-on reasoning persona. For normal use, revise or configure it as task-scoped guidance, remove identity and permanence language, and keep it subordinate to system, developer, and user instructions.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Artifact text confirms the concern: README and SKILL.md repeatedly describe identity-level or always-on behavior, which is not necessary for a bounded reasoning framework.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Artifact text contains an internal contradiction: SKILL.md says it complements rather than replaces agent policy, while nearby sections tell the agent that this is its identity and mind.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad activation phrases are partly expected for a general reasoning aid, but they become more concerning when paired with persistent identity instructions.
